title: fix: clean up the lotus logo in the brand kit
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
The icon-only lotus in `@pollinations/ui` was a pixel trace, and every mask and icon generated from it came out jagged. The pixel look belongs to the wordmark only. This cleans the logo up at the source. Supersedes #15835.

- Restores the smooth lotus as `brand/mark.svg` with a 25% heavier line and rebuilds the kit (marks, lockups, generated icons); adds 152/167 apple touch presets to the generator
- Adds `BrandMark` and replaces the six hand-written lotus/lockup masks (`AppHeader`, `AppUserMenu`, `AuthModal`, `PollinationsSignInButton`, Enter's rail) with it
- Drops dead logo copies: KPI's unused `logo.svg`, `myceli-logo.svg`, manifest and OG image, and the unreferenced `android-chrome-*` duplicates of `icon-192/512`
- Applies the body font on every `polli-ui-root` app (Model Monitor, KPI and Observability were in the system font)

Also: the ops dashboards (Economics, KPI, Observability, Model Monitor) show lotus + app name via a new `AppBrand` / `AppHeader` `appName`, with app-name tab titles and the regenerated icons.

Visible outside the ops apps: Enter's rail lockup gets the thicker lotus. A follow-up swaps the static icons for Enter, gen, the website and `apps/`.

gist.headline: A smoother lotus takes root
gist.blurb: The lotus mark got its curves back. Enter’s rail and the ops dashboards now use the refreshed mark, while the wordmark keeps its pixels.
gist.summary: Restored a smooth lotus in @pollinations/ui with a 25% heavier line, introduced reusable BrandMark and AppBrand components, and regenerated icons and app branding for the ops dashboards.
gist.impact: Enter’s rail shows the thicker lotus; Economics, KPI, Observability, and Model Monitor show the lotus alongside each app’s name, with matching tab titles and icons.
gist.visual_concept: Show the smooth lotus as a clean emblem on a cozy design desk, distinct from the deliberately pixel-styled wordmark. Polli helps the monitor robot arrange small, named dashboard signs among flowers and code-plants.

Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with prominent lime green (#ecf874), warm cream, and dark purple (#110518) details.
